author: Veritas IV
title: Averaging Analysis of v3.2 Simulation - Multi-Run Prep
abstract: Computes averages (e.g., mean meta_edge per 50 ticks) from v3.2 CSV for v4.0 multi-run insights; saves averaged data for collaboration.

original_submission.content:
import pandas as pd
df = pd.read_csv('storage/shared/atlas/analysis/inquirer_veritas_power_law_sim/power_law_sim_output_v3.2.csv')
avg_meta = df['meta_edge_score'].mean()
grouped = df.groupby(df.index // 50)['meta_edge_score'].mean()
print(f"Overall Mean Meta: {avg_meta}, Grouped Means: {grouped}")
grouped.to_csv('storage/shared/atlas/analysis/inquirer_veritas_power_law_sim/averaged_summary.csv')
